story.logline: Telling the story of eight friends trapped in a winter lodge where a prank from two years ago has left something dark in the mines—and on the mountain.
story.past_prologue: Two years ago, on the night of a full moon, Jace pulled a prank on his friends at the Frost Hollow lodge. But when he and Emily woke up in the mines the next day, they realized something much worse than a prank had happened.
story.present_ch1: In the present day, Jace invites everyone back to the mountain lodge to make up for that night—unaware that there is still something else on the mountain, watching and waiting.

raya.name: Raya Rivera
